meta.basis: PTD like-for-like: LY W30 restricted to Sun–Wed to match TY (DECISIONS D3). Counts are SAMPLE-scale (D11).

definitions.wos: end-of-week ON_HAND_UNITS / avg weekly units over trailing <=4 full weeks
definitions.L4W: selected week and 3 prior (truncated before W26)

meta.ratio_rule: Ratios are computed from totals, never averaged across weeks.
